text:
Type: three-seat leather sofa
Use: seating, lounging, watching TV; living room, den, lounge
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: smooth leather upholstery with stitched seams, small black block feet
Colors: black, glossy black
Shape: deep boxy frame, wide low flat arms, two loose back and seat cushions, nearly floor-level base, low and bulky
Feel: sleek, solid, comfortable, bold
Goes with: white or grey walls, chrome or glass tables, light wood floors; modern, contemporary or industrial living rooms

product.name: KIVIK
product.description: KIVIK is a generous seating series with a soft, deep seat and comfortable support for your back.
